checkedAlternates.risk: Bone china is fired slightly lower than hard-paste kaolin porcelain.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Bone china achieves full vitrification and high translucency (group-4), unlike opaque stoneware (group-3).

checkedAlternates.risk: Greenware is often made from low-fire earthenware clay.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Greenware has not yet undergone bisque firing in a kiln (group-1), unlike fired earthenware (group-2).
